```{r}
# ref level is the third level
d_vgam <- d |>
  mutate(
    admission = fct_relevel(admission,
                            "Urgent",
                            "Emergency",
                            "Elective"))

# mod_full_vgam <-
#   vglm(admission ~ died + white + los + age + provnum,
#        family = multinomial, dat = d_vgam)

mod_trimmed_vgam <-
  vglm(admission ~ died + white + los,
       family = multinomial, dat = d_vgam)

mod_null_vgam <-
  vglm(admission ~ 1,
       family = multinomial, dat = d_vgam)

1-logLik(mod_trimmed_vgam)/logLik(mod_null_vgam)
```

```{r}
summary(mod_trimmed_vgam)

AIC(mod_null_vgam)
BIC(mod_null_vgam)

AIC(mod_trimmed_vgam)
BIC(mod_trimmed_vgam)
```

This model ran into the issue of the hospital ID numbers having perfect separation as some levels have only one admission type

```{r}
# ref level is the first level
d_nnet <- d |>
  mutate(
    admission = fct_relevel(admission,
                            "Elective",
                            "Urgent",
                            "Emergency"))

mod_full_nnet <-
  multinom(admission ~ died + white + los + provnum,
       data = d_nnet)

summary(mod_full_nnet)
```


## model assessment

```{r}
df <- d |>
  select(c(died, white, los))

# phi_matrix <- cor(df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
# print(phi_matrix)


df_expanded <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = df, na.action = "na.pass")

# Calculate unified matrix
# This handles Phi (Bin/Bin), Point-Biserial (Bin/Int), and Pearson (Int/Int) simultaneously
phi_matrix <- cor(df_expanded, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

as.data.frame(phi_matrix) |>
  kable(digits = 2)
```


```{r}
mn.is.resid<-residuals(mod_trimmed_vgam)
mn.is.fitted<-fitted(mod_trimmed_vgam)
mn.is.observed<-mn.is.fitted+mn.is.resid[,1]
par(mfrow=c(1,3))
for(i in 1:3){
  plot(mn.is.fitted[,i],mn.is.observed[,i],main=colnames(mn.is.fitted)[i],xlab="fitted p",ylab="observed p")
  abline(a=0,b=1)
  lines(smooth.spline(mn.is.fitted[,i],mn.is.observed[,i],df=4),col="red",lty=2)
}
```

```{r}
# Get predictions (Fix: exclude obs_row_id from pivot)
preds <- predict(mod_trimmed_vgam, type = "response") %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  mutate(obs_row_id = row_number()) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-obs_row_id, names_to = "level", values_to = "fitted_prob")

# Extract actual outcomes
actuals <- model.matrix(~ admission - 1, data = d_vgam) %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  mutate(obs_row_id = row_number()) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-obs_row_id, names_to = "level_col", values_to = "is_event") %>% 
  mutate(level = str_remove(level_col, "admission")) %>% 
  select(-level_col)

# Combine, Bin, and Plot
preds %>% 
  left_join(actuals, by = c("obs_row_id", "level")) %>% 
  mutate(bin = ntile(fitted_prob, 10)) %>% 
  group_by(level, bin) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_fitted = mean(fitted_prob),
    mean_observed = mean(is_event),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_fitted, y = mean_observed)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
  facet_wrap(~level, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Calibration Plot", x = "Predicted Probability", y = "Observed Proportion") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
preds <- preds |>
  group_by(obs_row_id) |>
  # Returns the level corresponding to the highest probability for that observation
  mutate(guess = level[which.max(fitted_prob)]) |>
  ungroup() # Always good practice after grouping

actuals <- actuals |>
  group_by(obs_row_id) |>
  mutate(real = level[which.max(is_event)]) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
j <- preds %>% 
  left_join(actuals, by = c("obs_row_id", "level")) 
```



```{r}
# Isolate true and predicted results, then merge
classification_data <- actuals |>
  # Filter to get the true outcome (is_event == 1) and rename the column
  filter(is_event == 1) |>
  select(obs_row_id, Observed = level) |>
  # Join with the predicted classification
  inner_join(
    preds |> select(obs_row_id, Predicted = guess) |> distinct(),
    by = "obs_row_id"
  )

# Generate confusion matrix and format for display
confusion_matrix <- classification_data |>
  select(Observed, Predicted) |>
  table() |>
  as_tibble() |>
  # Pivot to a wide format, prefixing the column headers
  pivot_wider(names_from = Predicted, values_from = n, names_prefix = "Predicted_") |>
  rename(True_Outcome = Observed)

print(confusion_matrix)
```
